videos.title: Imanari Roll by Masakazu Imanari
videos.whyUseful: The namesake of the technique teaches the roll himself, so the entry mechanics come from the source rather than a second-hand breakdown.

videos.title: The Easiest Way To Do The Imanari Roll
videos.whyUseful: Breaks the roll down step by step, shoulder line first, which is what you need when the dive keeps stalling.

videos.title: How To Do The Imanari Roll (From Tie-Up Snap Down) - ZombieProofBJJ (NoGi)
videos.whyUseful: Shows the no-gi entry timed off a tie-up snap down, the most common way to set the roll up against a standing opponent.

videos.title: Leg Scissor Takedowns | Kani Basami & Imanari Roll
videos.whyUseful: Puts the rolling entry next to the scissor takedown and covers the knee-injury risk, the safety side of the same movement family.
